messages:
Priya Raman: Quick sync — final readiness checklist for the marketplace listing next Wednesday. Need owners on: listing metadata, press embargo alignment, SI integration docs, hardware SKU packaging, landing page cutover window, tracking pixels. Who can own which item?
Matt Chen: I can take listing metadata + pricing SKU mapping. Starting a tiny doc now -> https://tiny.redwood/marketplace-metadata :point_right:
Lisa Gomez: I’ll own press/embed copy + embargo schedule. Want to confirm embargo window: proposed Tue 18:00 UTC embargo lift, press release 18:30 UTC. Is that ok for legal?
Amelia (Partner Ops): noted. Legal asked for final copy by Mon EOD. Also need partner logos in svg and verified wording for SI name credits. Can partners consent be captured by Wed morning?
Priya Raman: @Amelia add a checklist item: "partner logo + trademark signoff". If any partner misses signoff by Tue 12:00 UTC we move them to the secondary rollout.
Oliver Park: For SI integrations — docs are in staging, but we need a one-click onboarding snippet (npm package + quickstart). ETA to finish: Tuesday 09:00 PT. We also need sample config for tenant provisioning.
Matt Chen: tagging eng-runtime for a tiny runtime flag to accept the marketplace model labels. @DeployBot can we reserve the staging cutover window on infra?
DeployBot: staging-cutover: reserved 2025-11-12T09:30:00Z -> 2025-11-12T10:30:00Z for workspace:marketplace-staging. Notification sent to #eng-releases.
Lisa Gomez: Copy deadline: Mon EOD. Localization: Spanish and German must be in by Tue 07:00 UTC. I can coordinate translators but need the master copy by Mon 08:00 PT.
Amelia (Partner Ops): Partner collateral status: AWS listing ready, Azure needs final SKU mapping from hardware team, HW partner (EdgeFabric) asking for a 1hr preflight call Wed 07:00 UTC.
Priya Raman: EdgeFabric preflight: @Oliver or @Matt on that call? We need to confirm packaging and any SKU differences for on-prem vs cloud.
Oliver Park: I can join the preflight. Can someone make a short agenda? Suggest: 1) SKU mapping, 2) image assets & sizing, 3) version pinning, 4) install snippet test. 20 min max.
Matt Chen: I pushed a small PR with SKU table to the repo: https://git.redwood/schemas/sku-table (PR #442). Please review — it has the on-prem vs cloud pricing delta.
Lisa Gomez: Marketing tracking — need final UTM scheme and analytics events. Proposed utm_source=marketplace, utm_medium=listing, utm_campaign=partner-launch-2025. Also add a param for partner_id.
Priya Raman: Good. Ops question: landing page cutover — do we redirect existing /marketplace to new listing on release or do a toggle? Risk: TTL & cache. Preference: toggle with CDN purge. Thoughts?
Oliver Park: Toggle preferred. We can flip an env var and invalidate CDN via our API. Less risky than immediate redirect. I'll add a rollback playbook to the runbook.
Amelia (Partner Ops): Partner comms: pushing a partner-ready email Tue 14:00 PT. Must include testing checklist and contact for SI support.
Matt Chen: Blocker: one hardware partner requested a different legal name in listing (DBA vs corp). Legal flagged it — need signoff. @Lisa can you coordinate with legal?
Lisa Gomez: On it. I'll loop in legal and update the copy. If unresolved by Tue 12:00 UTC, we default to corporate name and note DBA in partner notes.
Priya Raman: Action items summary: Matt = listing metadata + SKU PR, Lisa = press + localization + legal loop, Oliver = SI onboarding snippet + EdgeFabric preflight + CDN rollback runbook, Amelia = partner signoffs + email. Everyone confirm and add any missing blockers.
Matt Chen: Confirmed.
Lisa Gomez: Confirmed.
Oliver Park: Confirmed.
Amelia (Partner Ops): Confirmed — scheduling preflight and partner reminders now.
DeployBot: reminder: please upload final assets to /releases/marketplace/assets by 2025-11-10T23:59:00Z or they will be excluded from primary listing.
Priya Raman: Thanks team — will run a dry-run on Tue 16:00 PT in the staging channel. If anyone can't make it DM me. :thumbsup:
